verdict.rationale: Ardent has no documented export or offboarding feature. However, its source of truth is your own Postgres (Supabase, RDS, self-hosted), and every branch is exposed as a standard Postgres connection URL. Your data therefore stays in an open, portable format you can reach with standard Postgres tooling, and leaving mostly means disconnecting. The CLI also emits stable JSON for branch metadata. Missing for 10: an explicit documented data/metadata export feature, an account-deletion and offboarding path, and independent confirmation of data portability.
